m.d: You use actually to say that something is real; in fact; really.
m.e: Actually, I had nothing to do with that incident.

m.d: Something done, a deed.
m.e: Going into the house on fire to help a child was a brave act.

m.d: An act is a law made by the government.
m.e: The UK's Freedom of Information Act was passed in 2004. It lets people ask questions of the government.

m.d: An act is when you do something to make people believe something other than the truth.
m.e: Susan seems nice, but it's all an act.

m.d: If you act in some way, you do something that makes people think you are that way.
m.e: When he must do something, he acts quickly.

m.d: If you act, you perform in a film or a play.
m.e: Daniel Radcliffe acts in the Harry Potter films.

m.d: To the other side.
m.e: I walked across the bridge.

m.d: On the other side.
m.e: I can see him across the street.

m.d: Crossing, on both sides of.
m.e: The bridge is across the stream.

m.d: Accident means something that happens without a plan; unintentionally; inadvertently.
m.e: I dropped the glass by accident and it broke.

m.d: An accident is a vehicle crash.
m.e: Two people were hurt in a road traffic accident between a car and a motorcycle last night.

m.d: If you accept something, you take it when somebody gives it to you.
m.e: She accepted the award.

m.d: If you accept something, you believe it as true or valid.
m.e: I accept your plan.

m.d: An action is something that you do, or something that happens, especially with motion.
m.e: At 3 am, just west of the building, the plan was put into action.

m.d: If something is true according to a source, it means that source says or shows that it is true.
m.e: According to a friend of mine, they are thinking of building a new mall near here.

m.d: An acting director, president, head, etc. is in the position until the regular person returns to the job.
m.e: He was the acting chairperson for the committee when Tim went for surgery.

m.d: An account is an arrangement with a bank or other company to do business.
m.e: I opened a bank account when I moved into town.

m.d: The records of the money that is paid or received. (often plural)
m.e: The accounts show that your bill has already been paid.

m.d: A description of events
m.e: The account that he gave didn't match the story that was in the newspaper.

m.d: If x accounts for some part of y, x makes up that part of y.
m.e: Payments to employees account for 73% of our budget.

m.d: If x accounts for y, it explains why y happens or exists.
m.e: Oh, she was sick. Well, that accounts for her poor test score.

m.d: If you have access to something, you can use it, look at it, enter it, etc.
m.e: As a student, you have access to all our facilities including the library and computers.

m.d: If you access something, you get information from it, usually using a computer.
m.e: The product enables multiple systems to access a single database.

m.d: An actor is a person (usually male) who performs as a character in a play or other theatrical work. A female performer is called either an actress or an actor.
m.e: The actor received a Tony Award.

m.d: An actual thing is one that exists; it is real.
m.e: People call me Peter, but my actual name is Pierre.

m.d: Accepted ideas are agreed by most people to be correct or reasonable.
m.e: There is no generally accepted definition of life.

m.d: The accused is a person who is on trial for some crime.
m.e: The accused claimed that he did not murder the young girl.

m.d: An accent is the particular way that somebody's speech sounds.
m.e: I can speak French, but I do it with an English accent.

When a person or animal has activity, it is active or lively.
m.e: The sleeping dog did not show much activity.

m.d: When you have a function to do, you have an activity.
m.e: The child has many after-school activities.

m.d: An actress is a female who performs as a character in a play or other theatrical work.
m.e: The main actress went up and bowed to the audience.

m.d: An academy is an educational organization, similar to a university or college.
m.e: She passed the exams to enter the local academy.

m.d: An academy is a place for special training, such as a military academy.
m.e: I learnt about horses at the riding academy.

m.d: An academy is a group of experts in a particular field of arts or science, who regulate and promote their speciality.
m.e: He was made an honorary member of The Academy of American Poets.

m.d: Something is active if it is turned on or started.
m.e: One of the computers was active: its screen was bright.

m.d: If someone is active, he or she does exercise often or participates often.
m.e: She was such an active 80-year-old that she ran the Boston Marathon.

m.d: A sentence is active if its subject does the action.
m.e: "Athena helped Odysseus" is an active sentence because Athena is the one who helped.

m.d: If you achieve success or a goal, you have completed what you planned to do or have a good result.
m.e: She achieved a grade of 98% in her English class.

m.d: In card games, an ace is a card of value 1. In some games it is the card with the highest value
In tennis, a player hits an ace when the opponent doesn't hit the serve
If you say someone is an ace at something, they are excellent at it.
An acid is a liquid with a high number of hydrogen ions in it that can burn things.
m.e: Fruit often has a little acid in it.

m.d: If something is acid, it is like an acid, from an acid, or acidic.
m.e: The factories nearby have made the lake more acid.

m.d: If something has an acid taste, it is sour.
If something said or done to you was acid, it was hurtful.
m.e: Their acid comments are painful.

m.d: Accidentally means something happens by chance; unintentionally; inadvertently.
m.e: Sorry, I accidentally dropped it.

m.d: Something accurate is correct or exact.
m.e: We need to provide people with more accurate information.

m.d: If one thing accompanies something else, it comes or goes with it, or they happen together.
m.e: She accompanied me to the hospital after my accident.

m.d: If person A accompanies person B on a musical instrument, B sings or plays the main part while A plays along.
m.e: Joe Falcon sings and plays the accordion and is accompanied by Cleoma Breaux on guitar.

m.d: If someone is accomplished at something, they are very good at it.
m.e: She is an accomplished painter.

m.d: If you accuse someone, you say they did something, usually something bad.
m.e: Tim accuses Bill of the crime.

m.d: An accountant is someone who is skilled in keeping or adjusting accounts.
m.e: The accountant helps to keep track of the status of your bank accounts.

m.d: If you accomplish something, you succeed in doing or completing something.
m.e: They are skeptical about how much will be accomplished by legislation.

m.d: An accomplice is a person who helps someone with a crime.
If someone is accepting, they are very tolerant.
If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.
m.e: The government yesterday acknowledged the need for more money.

m.d: If you acknowledge something, you say publicly that it is good.
m.e: She isn't very good at acknowledging the work of her staff.

m.d: When something is acceptable it is capable of being accepted or is worth being accepted.
m.e: You ideas are acceptable to the group.

m.d: When something is welcome or pleasing, it is acceptable.
m.e: Any kind words for my work are acceptable.

m.d: To activate means to make something active.
m.e: The machine activated the screensaver because it was idle.

m.d: An acquaintance is someone you know slightly but not well.
m.e: He's an old acquaintance of mine.

m.d: An achievement is something that is or was achieved.
m.e: Winning a championship is a great achievement.

m.d: Accounting involves keeping records on financial information.
An accounting goes over an event that happened and the explanation for why it happened.
An academic is a researcher or university teacher.
m.e: The government has begun jailing journalists and banning academics from travel.

m.d: Academics is the part of school related to learning.
m.e: This class was strong in every aspect of their schooling, including academics, athletics and extracurricular activities.

m.d: An academic topic, lecture, idea, etc., is one that is connected to education.
m.e: The academic staff at the college generally don't teach during the summer.

m.d: If you have an ache in a part of your body, it hurts a little and doesn't stop fast.
m.e: Phil has an ache in his side.

m.d: If part of your body aches, it hurts a little for a long time.
m.e: Skip's head aches from his run.

m.d: An accusation is a claim that someone did something.
m.e: He made the accusation that the boy murdered the young girl.

m.d: Accidental means done unintentionally; inadvertently, not on purpose; not deliberately.
m.e: The jury returned a verdict of accidental death.

m.d: If you acquire something, you buy or get it.
m.e: XYZ company has acquired a new factory in Shanghai.

m.d: If an angle is acute, it is less than 90 degrees in size.
m.e: I had to measure the size of the acute angle in math class. It was 35 degrees in size.

m.d: Acceptance is when someone agrees with something or accepts something.
m.e: The acceptance of this man in his new role is big.

m.d: An accessory is an extra item, not needed, but which adds to the whole.
m.e: She bought a number of accessories including a bag, hat, and gloves, to match her new dress.

m.d: An accessory is a person who helps someone to break the law.
m.e: Because she helped him hide the body after the murder, she was charged with being an accessory to the crime.

m.d: If something is done accordingly, it is done in a comfortable or agreeable manner.
If you are accountable for something that people are not happy about, you need to explain or apologize for it.
m.e: Governments must be accountable for the way they spend people's taxes.

m.d: If x accommodates y, x has or makes room for y.
m.e: The platform didn't look nearly big enough to accommodate a ship the size of the Lady Luck

m.d: If a place accommodates people, they stay, work, or live there.
m.e: The school residence currently accommodates students from 27 countries.

m.d: If you accommodate someone or something, you do what is needed to help or understand them.
m.e: Our restaurant can accommodate the needs of people with special diets.

m.d: Accuracy is the state of being accurate.
If two or more things are in accord, they match or agree.
m.e: We are in accord that the bridge should be built.

m.d: An accord is a formal agreement between two or more countries or groups.
m.e: The Czech government signed an accord with the United States allowing Washington to use some Czech land for its armed forces.

m.d: When two things accord with each other, they agree.
m.e: Amy can trust him because his words accord with his actions.

m.d: If something is done accurately, it is done correctly or with accuracy; it is not wrong.
m.e: The scientists accurately predicted the results of the experiment.

m.d: An activist is someone who is trying to change a situation, especially one that is political or environmental.
m.e: He is an activist for Greenpeace.

m.d: An accelerator is the pedal in a vehicle which you step on to make it go faster.
m.e: He took his foot off the accelerator and the car started to slow down.

m.d: (usually accommodations in American English) Accommodation is a place to stay or live.
m.e: The hotel provides high quality accommodation, mostly for foreign visitors.

m.d: Accommodation is the process or result of changing something to fit a particular need or situation.
m.e: During the 1990s Iran tried twice to reach an accommodation with its long time rival.

m.d: If two or more things are in accord, they match or agree.
m.e: We are in accordance that the bridge should be built.

m.d: If something is done actively, it is done in a way that is active.
If you are driving and you accelerate your car, you make it go faster.
m.e: They accelerate at the end of the curve.

m.d: An accordion is a musical instrument that makes sounds by moving air over reeds by using bellows.
m.e: He plays the accordion in the street to make tips.

m.d: An accomplishment is something that has been achieved successfully.
m.e: Winning a gold medal from the Olympics is one of her greatest accomplishments.

m.d: An acre is an imperial measure of area. One acre is 4,840 square yards or 4047 square metres.
m.e: The lower field on his farm is more than 2 acres.

m.d: If something is accessible, you can use it, look at it, enter it, etc.
m.e: The building has been changed to make it wheelchair accessible.

m.d: If someone is accessible, they are friendly and easy to talk to.
If a space has good acoustics (or sometimes acoustic) its physical structure makes it easy to hear sound in it.
m.e: She hated singing in the gym because of the poor acoustics.

m.d: Related to hearing or sounds.
An acoustic instrument is played without electricity.
m.e: I think music from an acoustic guitar is prettier than music from an electric guitar.

m.d: If something is accelerated, it is being done faster than it usually is done.
m.e: The child was put into an accelerated education program because she was a fast learner.

m.d: Acceleration is a change in speed.
m.e: As the plane took off, the acceleration pressed her into her seat.

m.d: Acceleration is by how much a speed or velocity goes up.
Derivative for velocity, has formula a= lim _(Δx→0)(Δv)/(Δt) .
Acquisition is the act of getting something, often by buying it.
m.e: The judge ruled that the acquisition of XYZ company by Acme Inc. was illegal.

m.d: An acquisition is something that you got.
m.e: The zoo's last acquisition was three elephants.

m.d: Activation is the action or progress of making something active or operative.
Acne is an infection of the skin, usually on the face, usually in teens.
Acupuncture is a method of treating medical problems by using needles to apply pressure to certain areas of the human body.
m.e: My doctor used acupuncture to help cure my symptoms.

m.d: An acorn is a fruit of the oak.
If you accumulate something, you bring it together.
m.e: He worried that the paperwork would accumulate on his desk if he took a day off work.

m.d: An acquittal is the action of saying someone is not guilty of a crime.
Academics is the part of school related to learning.
m.e: This class was strong in every aspect of their schooling, including academics, athletics and extracurricular activities.

m.d: If you accustom someone to something, you make them familiar with, or used to it.
m.e: He accustomed the farm girl to city life.

m.d: If you acquaint someone with something, you make them familiar with it.
m.e: Are you acquainted with Mr. Green?

m.d: If someone is acquitted of a crime, they have been tried in a court and found not guilty.
m.e: He was acquitted of murder but found guilty of manslaughter.
